title: Exterior Angles of Triangles Core Test
description: Use exterior angle relationships, linear pairs, and algebraic reasoning to find unknown triangle angles.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles of 45 degrees and 68 degrees. What is the exterior angle at the third vertex?
questions.explanation: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles: 45 + 68 = 113.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle of a triangle is formed outside one vertex. Its remote interior angles are 32 degrees and 79 degrees. What is the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: Add the remote interior angles: 32 + 79 = 111.

questions.questionText: A triangle has an exterior angle of 124 degrees. One remote interior angle is 57 degrees. What is the other remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle equals the sum of the remote interior angles, so 124 - 57 = 67.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 136 degrees. One remote interior angle is 82 degrees. What is the other remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: Subtract the known remote interior angle from the exterior angle: 136 - 82 = 54.

questions.questionText: An interior angle of a triangle is 71 degrees. What is the exterior angle that forms a linear pair with it?
questions.explanation: An interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle form a straight line, so 180 - 71 = 109.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle and its adjacent interior angle form a linear pair. If the exterior angle is 118 degrees, what is the adjacent interior angle?
questions.explanation: Linear-pair angles add to 180 degrees. 180 - 118 = 62.

questions.questionText: Which two angles add to make an exterior angle of a triangle?
options: the adjacent interior angle and one remote angle
questions.explanation: The exterior angle theorem says an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles of 51 degrees and 43 degrees. What is the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 51 + 43 = 94 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has an exterior angle of 101 degrees and one remote interior angle of 36 degrees. What is the other remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: Use exterior = remote + remote. 101 - 36 = 65.

questions.questionText: An interior angle and exterior angle at one triangle vertex form a straight line. The interior angle is 88 degrees. What is the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles are supplementary: 180 - 88 = 92.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles x degrees and 74 degrees. The exterior angle is 119 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has remote interior angles 2x degrees and 48 degrees. The exterior angle is 104 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has remote interior angles x + 12 degrees and 63 degrees. The exterior angle is 128 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has an exterior angle of 142 degrees and adjacent interior angle y degrees. What is y?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles form a linear pair, so y = 180 - 142 = 38.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 3x + 10 degrees. Its remote interior angles are 50 degrees and 2x degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The exterior equals the remote sum: 3x + 10 = 50 + 2x, so x = 40.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle measures 4x - 8 degrees. The remote interior angles are 2x + 14 degrees and 56 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has adjacent interior angle 64 degrees. The two remote interior angles are 43 degrees and z degrees. What is z?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 180 - 64 = 116 degrees. Then z = 116 - 43 = 73.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 125 degrees. Its remote interior angles are x degrees and x + 15 degrees. What is x?
A triangle's exterior angle is 116 degrees. The adjacent interior angle is 64 degrees. What must the two remote interior angles add to?
questions.explanation: The remote interior angles add to the exterior angle, so they add to 116 degrees.

questions.questionText: A student says the exterior angle is 70 degrees because the adjacent interior angle is 110 degrees. What correction is needed?
options: The exterior angle is 70 degrees, but it also equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
The exterior angle should be 110 degrees.
The exterior angle should be 180 degrees.
The triangle cannot have a 110 degree interior angle.
questions.correctAnswer: The exterior angle is 70 degrees, but it also equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
questions.explanation: The arithmetic 180 - 110 = 70 is correct, and the exterior angle theorem gives the same value as the remote-angle sum.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles 4x degrees and 3x + 5 degrees. The exterior angle is 96 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has an exterior angle of 132 degrees. One remote interior angle is twice the other. What is the smaller remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: Let the smaller angle be x. Then x + 2x = 132, so x = 44.

questions.questionText: The remote interior angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2:5. The exterior angle is 126 degrees. What is the larger remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: There are 7 parts, so each part is 18 degrees. The larger angle is 5 x 18 = 90 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has an exterior angle of 108 degrees. One remote interior angle is 47 degrees. What is the adjacent interior angle?
questions.explanation: The adjacent interior angle forms a linear pair with the exterior angle: 180 - 108 = 72.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 2x + 34 degrees. Its remote interior angles are 48 degrees and x - 6 degrees. What is x?
An exterior angle measures 2x + 18 degrees. The adjacent interior angle measures x + 42 degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles add to 180: 2x + 18 + x + 42 = 180, so 3x = 120 and x = 40.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles 36 degrees and 58 degrees. Which equation correctly finds the exterior angle e?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 117 degrees and one remote interior angle 49 degrees. Which equation finds the other remote interior angle r?
questions.explanation: The two remote interior angles add to the exterior angle.

questions.questionText: A triangle has adjacent interior angle 73 degrees. Which expression gives the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles are supplementary.

questions.questionText: The two remote interior angles of a triangle are 2x + 4 degrees and x + 20 degrees. The exterior angle is 96 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has an exterior angle of 140 degrees. The remote interior angles are x + 25 degrees and 2x + 10 degrees. What is the larger remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: x + 25 + 2x + 10 = 140, so 3x + 35 = 140 and x = 35. The remote angles are 60 and 80 degrees.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 150 degrees. The adjacent interior angle is 30 degrees. One remote interior angle is 96 degrees. What is the other remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: The remote interior angles add to the exterior angle, so the missing remote angle is 150 - 96 = 54.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles 5x degrees and 4x degrees. The adjacent interior angle is 72 degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 180 - 72 = 108. Then 5x + 4x = 108, so x = 12.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 2x + 30 degrees. The adjacent interior angle is 3x degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The adjacent interior and exterior angles add to 180: 2x + 30 + 3x = 180, so x = 30.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 122 degrees. Its remote interior angles differ by 18 degrees. What is the larger remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: The remote angles add to 122 and differ by 18. The larger is (122 + 18) / 2 = 70.

questions.questionText: A triangle has remote interior angles 3x + 8 degrees and 2x - 5 degrees. The adjacent interior angle is 72 degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 180 - 72 = 108. Then 3x + 8 + 2x - 5 = 108, so 5x + 3 = 108 and x = 21.

questions.questionText: The remote interior angles of a triangle are x + 14 degrees and 2x + 1 degrees. The exterior angle is 129 degrees. What is the smaller remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: x + 14 + 2x + 1 = 129, so 3x + 15 = 129 and x = 38. The remote angles are 52 and 77 degrees.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 6x - 11 degrees. Its adjacent interior angle is 2x + 31 degrees. What is the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: The two angles form a linear pair: 6x - 11 + 2x + 31 = 180, so 8x + 20 = 180 and x = 20. The exterior angle is 109 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 135 degrees. The remote interior angles are in the ratio 4:5. What is the smaller remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: The ratio has 9 parts. Each part is 15 degrees, so the smaller remote angle is 4 x 15 = 60 degrees.

questions.questionText: A student writes e + 48 + 67 = 180 to find an exterior angle e. What is the mistake?
options: The remote interior angles should be subtracted from 90.
The exterior angle must be less than both remote angles.
The exterior angle should equal 48 + 67, not complete the triangle sum.
questions.correctAnswer: The exterior angle should equal 48 + 67, not complete the triangle sum.
questions.explanation: The interior angles of the triangle add to 180, but an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 118 degrees. One remote interior angle is 3x + 4 degrees and the other is x - 6 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has adjacent interior angle x + 20 degrees. Its remote interior angles are 48 degrees and x - 4 degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 180 - (x + 20), and it equals 48 + x - 4. So 160 - x = x + 44, giving x = 58.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle is 3x + 18 degrees. The remote interior angles are x + 30 degrees and x + 24 degrees. What is the adjacent interior angle?
questions.explanation: 3x + 18 = x + 30 + x + 24, so x = 36. The exterior angle is 126 degrees, so the adjacent interior angle is 180 - 126 = 54 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 126 degrees. One remote interior angle is equal to the adjacent interior angle. The other remote interior angle is 72 degrees. What is the equal angle?
questions.explanation: The adjacent interior angle is 180 - 126 = 54 degrees. The other remote angle is 126 - 72 = 54 degrees, so the equal angle is 54 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle 3x + 16 degrees. Its remote interior angles are 2x - 12 degrees and 56 degrees. What is x?
A triangle has adjacent interior angle 68 degrees. Its remote interior angles differ by 20 degrees. What is the smaller remote interior angle?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 112 degrees. The remote angles add to 112 and differ by 20, so the smaller is (112 - 20) / 2 = 46.

questions.questionText: An exterior angle of a triangle is 144 degrees. The remote interior angles are x + 18 degrees and 2x degrees. Which remote angle is larger?
options: The adjacent interior angle is larger.
questions.explanation: x + 18 + 2x = 144, so x = 42. The remote angles are 60 and 84 degrees, so 2x is larger.

questions.questionText: A triangle has exterior angle e. The remote interior angles are a and b. Which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle theorem states that an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

questions.questionText: A student claims an exterior angle of 102 degrees can have remote interior angles of 46 degrees and 66 degrees. What should you say?
options: Yes, because both remote angles are acute.
No, because remote angles must be equal.
questions.explanation: The two remote interior angles must add to the exterior angle. Here they add to 112 degrees.

questions.questionText: A triangle has adjacent interior angle 3x - 5 degrees and remote interior angles x + 20 degrees and x + 15 degrees. What is x?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle is 180 - (3x - 5), and it equals x + 20 + x + 15. So 185 - 3x = 2x + 35, giving x = 30.
